title: slice-run review stub enforces review's prior-record admission rules
body:
Outcome: the krn review stub in test/slice/slice-run.test.ts refuses --prior-record whose record head equals --head, and --prior-record combined with --budget-exception, exactly as src/flow/prior.ts and src/flow/cli.ts do, so slice argv defects fail in unit tests instead of the review panel.
Evidence: PR #220 (t-w5w96da) review attempt 1 BLOCKING src/slice/run.ts:834: slice passed --prior-record on an unchanged head after main moved; the stub accepted it, the real receiver refuses it (KRN-12 receiver fidelity).
Proof: a stub-level test where slice argv carries --prior-record on the reviewed head exits 64 in the stub; existing slice tests stay green.
